controls.actual_rng: Restore Python/NumPy/Torch CPU stream after shared warp encoding; save initial unscaled noise, entry and all50 step states plus terminal
controls.warp_encoding: Original S85 RGB01 black holes 0 -> 2*RGB-1; original ft-mse wrapper deterministic mean*0.18215; chunk1 four targets once
controls.latent_mask: 576 bool support -> nonoverlapping avg_pool2d 8x8 -> 72 fractional support; history front4 zero; not confidence
controls.G0: One unmodified original 50-step sampling chain via transparent hooks, no clean fusion
controls.Gguide: One original 50-step chain, after every original CFG clean prediction fuse at lambda .25; all descendants recompute
controls.Gpaste: Same G0 raw target RGB, original branch conversion/clamp RGB01, image mask*.25 fixed warp mixture, no model
controls.Gterminal: Same actual G0 last x_tilde/sigma_hat/next_sigma/raw_clean; fuse .25 then replay original to_d/Euler order; full8 original VAE decode once; no denoiser/no RNG

budget.estimate: Original S70 same settings about1475s per chain. Two new full chains expected about50min plus shared encode/terminal decode;90min cap with40min per-arm allows machine variability; no cap increase after outputs.

recording.model_snapshot: Actual params/buffers value,identity,modes before/after; learned weights frozen
recording.failure: Keep partial/error/actual counts; no automatic retry; uncaptured abrupt crash recorded by external supervisor

scoring.reference_read_after: All generation outputs closed and hashed; no reference bytes in generation
scoring.primary: Each emitted uint8 RGB squared error divided by255^2; all576x576x3 channels each frame; average all4 frames equally
scoring.primary_signed_contrast: MSE(Gguide)-MSE(Gterminal); negative favors Gguide. Also always report Gguide-G0 and Gguide-Gpaste.
scoring.exact_numerator: int64 SSE; signed total SSE differences exact; no inferential significance threshold
scoring.secondaries: Same fixed S85 image mask support and hole MSE, full denominators; empty region NA; no border metric
scoring.incomplete: Any missing frame, nonfinite raw, failed emission consistency => incomplete comparison; no zero filling or reduced frame average
scoring.independent_review: Different author offline saved fusion/Euler/emission/RNG review and independent scoring arithmetic; no real-model replay required

claim_boundary: One previously exposed scene,4 correlated targets,1noise draw; ordinary baseline manipulation, not blinded confirmation, long-horizon/dynamic consistency, statistical superiority or novel method. Gguide-Gterminal retains cumulative intervention-dose alternative; RGB/latent equal lambda is not equal RGB dose. Prediction support is not physical accuracy or visibility; encoder/decoder nonlocal. VMem+declared ft-mse variant not exact original VAE baseline.
